title: Miami Luxury Yacht with 2 Jet Skis, Skyline and Sandbars
blurb:
IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT AN ALL-INCLUSIVE OFFER.

Additional fees paid separately to third parties:
• Marina Pick-Up Fee: $200
• Fuel Fee: $100/ *Per Hour*
• Crew Payment: $100/*Per Hour*

Per US Coast Guard bareboat charter regulations, these fees must be paid directly to third parties and cannot pass through our hands, as this would be illegal.

Enjoy a unique blend of relaxation and excitement with this private yacht charter in Miami. Perfect for groups, this 60-foot yacht offers a flexible experience, allowing you to cruise the Miami River and beyond. With complimentary jet skis for charters of four hours or more, you can switch from laid-back sailing to fast-paced adventures at your leisure.

- Explore Miami's stunning skyline and islands from the comfort of your private yacht
- Tailor your journey to fit your interests and pace
- Includes bottled water, cooler, and Bluetooth sound system for onboard enjoyment
